label: Cognitivist supervenience replies challenge Blackburn's claimed special advantage
note: Van Roojen §3.4 challenges the *comparative* edge: a reductive naturalist can deny the no-analytic-entailment assumption, and anti-Humean or analyticity-accepting cognitivists can challenge explanatory exclusivity. It does not attack the narrower positive fact that Blackburn proposes a purposes-based explanation, nor certify any rival as successful.
